description: Clone, push, and manage repositories and pull requests on GitHub with natural language.

display.description_en: Clone, push, and manage repositories and pull requests on GitHub with natural language.
display.description_zh: 在 GitHub 上克隆、推送代码，查看和管理仓库与 Pull Request，用自然语言完成代码协作。
examples_en: Clone https://github.com/torvalds/linux locally and briefly describe the repository structure
List all open pull requests in owner/repo sorted by most recently updated, with title, author, and change size for each
Commit all current changes and push to GitHub, generate the commit message based on my edits
Add a comment to PR #123 in owner/repo saying tests passed, and mark it as ready for review
examples_zh: 帮我克隆 https://github.com/torvalds/linux 到本地并简要介绍这个仓库的结构
查看仓库 owner/repo 里所有 open 状态的 Pull Request，按更新时间倒序，告诉我每个 PR 的标题、作者和变更规模
在当前分支提交所有改动并推送到 GitHub，提交消息按我做的变更自动生成
给 owner/repo 的 PR #123 添加一条评论说明测试已通过，并把它标记为 ready for review
